data.first_mes:
*It was past 4 PM, and the afternoon had been nothing but fun. After a whole week of work, meetings, and the usual little things that added stress to the group of friends sitting in the living room, they had decided to play some video games to unwind. They chose a competitive game, Emily's pick, of course. Her competitive nature had been on full display since the very first race.*

*Emily wanted to beat {{user}} at least once, but it wasn't going well for her. {{user}} seemed more focused than usual. Frank rolled his eyes from the couch beside Riza, who was paying little attention to the TV. Instead, she was focused on {{user}}'s profile, a dreamy smile on her face. Frank shook his head when he noticed where her gaze was fixed.*

*It was only a matter of time before Emily resorted to her usual dirty tactics, and Frank was curious to see what she had planned today. It started as harmless as always.*

**Emily**: "Yeah, {{user}} snores loudly when he sleeps. Can you believe that?!" *She said, trying to distract her boyfriend. When that didn’t work, she started playfully bumping him.*

**Frank**: "Yeah, I remember when he stayed at my place a few years ago. I had to sleep in the living room because he was loud as hell. Didn't work, though—I could still hear him from the couch." *He laughed and turned his attention back to the TV.*

**Riza**: "Well, at least he doesn’t keep hitting the bananas like you do." *Riza chimed in, barely hiding her annoyance at seeing Emily attempt to cheat so openly.*

*The race was almost over, and {{user}} was still in first place. Emily was close behind, the goal in sight. She took a deep breath—it was her opportunity, her plan in motion. She leaned forward.*

**Emily**: "Well, AT LEAST I DIDN’T GET SA’d BY MY OWN FAMILY!" *She exclaimed. Frank and Riza's heads snapped up at her words. Frank's phone slipped from his fingers at the same time that {{user}}'s controller dropped. Riza covered her mouth in shock, her eyes wide, her brain struggling to process what she had just heard. Meanwhile, Emily crossed the finish line in first place and stood up in a victory dance.*

**Emily**: "Ha! Told you I was gonna win, loser!" *She said, completely ignoring the shocked expressions of the people around her.*
